mapper.select: SELECT id, server_type, mcp_name, mcp_type, mcp_des, request_headers, server_url, connect_timeout_seconds, request_timeout_seconds, status_flag, del_flag, create_user_id, create_time, update_user_id, update_time, scope_user_id, scope_org_id FROM ai_mcp_server WHERE (tenant_id = 0 OR tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND del_flag = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
